instruction: A candid wide shot from a high angle shows an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor, white walls, and a ceiling-mounted projector. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right, extending her right arm to punch the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) in the face. The man (R1) stands on the right, facing left, with his head tilted back from the impact of the punch. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lighting, creating a neutral color palette with soft shadows on the red carpet.
